title: Worse single-step selectivity can win after removing product-generated competition
statement: For positive integer L and supplied nonnegative ratios rho0,s,rho_cap, compare P_A=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(1+rho0+s*j)^(-1) with P_B=(1+rho_cap)^(-L). Then P_B>P_A iff log(1+rho_cap)<(1/L)*sum_j log(1+rho0+s*j). For suitable L,s>0, a less selective isolated reaction with rho_cap>rho0 can have higher declared long-program correct probability by avoiding growing product-generated competition.

requires: Positive integer L and specified nonnegative ratio laws for both routes, with conditional stage-success definitions actually comparable.
Using the inequality to choose a physical route additionally requires the same acceptable functional output class; a native-amide requirement is not discharged by a heterocyclic endpoint.

assumptions: Constant model ratios and retained-product increment s are supplied, not inferred from isolated yield.
Distinct end-product chemistry, omitted error channels, kinetics and costs can defeat an apparent probability advantage.
costs: Compare complete endpoint functionality, donor/time/cleanup/masking costs and every relevant irreversible error; probability alone is not equal-resource performance.
contract.units: L is an instruction count; ratios, log averages and probabilities are dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: Acquire compatible final chemistry and full conditional error/cost laws before selecting the apparently higher-yield route.

body: Take logarithms of both strictly positive model probabilities and divide by L. This is an exact finite comparison; the small-ratio approximation rho_cap-rho0<s*(L-1)/2 is not the exact decision rule. When s=0 and rho_cap>rho0, route B cannot win by this mechanism. The source hypothetical first crossover482 and90.31/95.12 percent examples are not independently replayed or measured. The inequality compares declared correct-completion probabilities, not waiting time, donor use, reversible masking, cost or physical advantage. A physical choice additionally requires both endpoints to meet the same supplied functional target and all error classes to be included. Source thiazolidine/thiazepanone alternatives retain heterocyclic structure; if the target requires a native amide, this algebra does not make that different end product an admissible substitute. Off-template precursor capture and steric/guide footprints can change either assumed ratio or the legal output class. The unit exposes a mechanism-selection comparison, not an acquired chemistry interface.
